# asc_group_member (Resource)

Manages the membership of a user in a authorization group. Note: the authorization API does not expose a read endpoint for group membership, so drift cannot be detected — the resource relies on Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a group to add a member to
resource "asc_group" "example" {
  name = "platform-team"
}

# Add a user to the group
resource "asc_group_member" "example" {
  group_name = asc_group.example.name
  user_id    = "user-uuid-1234"
}

# Output the membership details
output "membership_id" {
  description = "The ID of the group membership (group_name:user_id)"
  value       = asc_group_member.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) The name of the group.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this membership.
